label: rem:brings-qou-axiom-map
title: QOU axioms instantiated on Bring's surface
html:
We record how each axiom of a quantum observable universe (quantum observable universe) is realised on Bring's surface.

(i) Non-degeneracy. The Frobenius form \int_A = h_q is the Haar state on A = \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)). Faithfulness of h_q for compact quantum groups supplies the isomorphism A \xrightarrow{ \sim } A^{\vee}. The antipode S and h_q define the dagger f^{\dagger} = h_q \circ \mu(S(f) \otimes -). This dagger is positive-definite (positive definite dagger) because the Haar state satisfies h_q(a^* a) > 0 for a \neq 0.

(ii) Observability. The adjoint representation decomposes as \mathrm{Ad}(A) \cong V_1 \oplus V_2 \oplus \cdots with no spin-0 summand. Thus \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 by the quantum Schur lemma. Geometrically, Bring's surface has no global holomorphic vector field (it has genus g = 4 > 1).

(iii) Categorical volume constraint. The fundamental object V of \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}_q(2)) has categorical dimension 2. In the archimedean realisation, V is the rank-2 defining representation carried by the state bundle fibre \mathcal{S}_p \cong \mathbb{C}^2 (Bring's QOU 4-tuple, item 3). The non-degenerate epimorphism \epsilon \colon \Lambda^2 V \to \mathbf{1} is instantiated by the Levi form L_\varTheta = -id\varTheta|_{H \times H} (archimedean realisations). Because L_\varTheta is alternating and non-degenerate on the rank-4 real distribution H = \ker\varTheta, it furnishes the symplectic pairing that makes V self-dual. This forces \det(g_V) = 1, selecting \mathrm{SU}(2) over \mathrm{GL}(2). In the spectral coordinates (Lagrange resolvents), this constraint manifests as the Hermitian quadric w_1 w_4 + w_2 w_3 = 0, which is the \mathrm{SL}(2) Plücker relation for \Lambda^2 V. The top-degree extension to the full color fibre is the spectral volume constraint. See Seiberg–Witten for the explicit symplectic form and its relation to \epsilon.
